verdict.rationale: Training-data privacy posture is a fair question for an LLM gateway and observability service that handles prompt data, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented training opt-out, no no-training policy, and no provider-side training controls. Self-hosting options are a related deployment choice, not a stated control over model training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
